members.author: AydarAkhmetzyanov
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Race condition in streamable HTTP: `post_writer` can receive messages before it is ready, because the caller yields control immediately after spawning the task. Both PRs fix this identically by importing `TaskStatus` from `anyio.abc` and adding a `task_status` parameter to `post_writer`, then calling `task_status.started(None)` before the message loop so the caller waits until the writer is actually ready.

members.title: feat: support stderr logging in Jupyter notebook environments
members.author: BabyChrist666
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2410: sys.stderr from Jupyter (and similar environments) is a virtual in-memory stream with no real file descriptor. members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2613: HTTP errors in the streamable HTTP client propagate as unhandled exceptions instead of being returned to the caller as JSON-RPC error responses.
